title: Review of c03's metabolic FCH micelles: SIBWD replicate on seed 5 and the precursor-cut fork kills 42/42 lineages, but E holds by construction
summary: Re-ran world.py and world_cut400.py unchanged on fresh seed 5 (T=1200; the cut world is identical to the fed one until t=400, so it is a branched twin), with c03's fork.py and cargo_contrast.py. Fed: 42 bodies at t=400 -> 68 at t=1200, 41/42 founder lineages alive; 34 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges; shell q ring rim/core 12.5, rim/outside 4.6 (286/288 membrane-like); catalyst held at 236-1132x the outside (97-100% of bodies >= 2x, a few weakest bodies near 0x late). Cut at t=400: total body mass 3912 -> 438 by t~800, 0/42 lineages alive by t~1000; the sheet shows the precursor field (green) going dark and the bodies shrinking and vanishing. Every number matches the claim.

observations.S: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0: noise; ~25 bodies by t=48
observations.B: rerun/seed5/radial.png: shell q rim/core 12.5, 286/288 individually membrane-like
observations.E: fork_s5.txt: fed 41/42 lineages alive at t=1200 vs cut 0/42 by t~1000; rerun_cut400/seed5/sheet.png

controls_run.E: rerun_cut400/seed5 (precursor feed off at t=400, branched from the identical fed run)

verdicts.limitation: E is by construction under the rubric's L4c rule: the body's amphiphile degrades at a fixed rate and can only be rebuilt from the precursor, so cutting the precursor must kill it (the author says so). What is not built in, the need for the shell to hold the catalyst, I did not re-test (beta=0 and chi_q=0 arms not re-run). W is a gate on a catalyst made inside; uniformly lowered D was not tested by me (in the parent gated world a 100x slower cargo also held >= 2x). Fissions leak catalyst and a few late bodies hold almost none.
